acceptance: Red test first: two consumed records with one id give an error that names both paths.
One record gives that record; none gives the not-found error unchanged.
100% statement coverage on each changed function; zero code comments.
fix: Make the consumed-record lookup return an error that names both paths when more than one record matches the id. Find the lookup by its callers in go/acs and go/internal/inboxmover.
source: operator decision 2026-11-03, docs/plans/architecture-decisions-2026-11.md AD2-0/AD3-4; survivor of acs-predicate-hardening
summary: An ACS predicate reads the consumed record of an inbox id. When two consumed records carry the same id, the lookup returns the first one, so a predicate can pass on the wrong record.
title: The consumed-record lookup refuses more than one record for one id
